stage: J-FAMP runbook Stage 2 (candidate quantization and clean evaluation)
scope: weight-only: Conv2d/Linear weights (53 tensors, 2202560 weights) are quantized; biases, BatchNorm parameters, running statistics and activations stay FP32

int_scale_policy.note: per-tensor and per-output-channel results are never mixed: every table row carries the granularity in its variant label and a role (primary | comparison). Protocol rule: if the previous JFAMP implementation used another policy than per-output-channel it is retained for both datasets and documented; the ResNet-18 implementation used per-tensor.

declared_constraints.note: only used here to flag the clean-accuracy shortlist on the validation split (column meets_delta_clean); value declared in the ResNet-18 run, must be identical for both protocol owners

alignment: each tensor is stored as its own contiguous byte array (no inter-tensor alignment padding); the .npz container overhead is not counted in any byte total
independence: each format is generated from the original FP32 checkpoint, never from another format

metric_definitions.sqnr_db: 10*log10(sum_i w_i^2 / sum_i (w_i - w^_i)^2), signal = FP32 weights, noise = FP32 weights minus decoded weights; per layer, and GLOBAL pooled over all 53 tensors (sums of powers, paper Eq. 6); float64
metric_definitions.mse/rmse/mae/max_abs_error: of w - w^ over the tensor (GLOBAL: pooled; MAE is the weight-weighted mean)
metric_definitions.n_clipped: weights whose magnitude exceeded the format's range before rounding (saturated)
metric_definitions.zeroed_from_nonzero: weights that are nonzero in FP32 but decode to exactly 0
metric_definitions.zero_count/zero_fraction: number / fraction of DECODED weights equal to zero (fp32_zero_count: the same count in the FP32 tensor)
metric_definitions.roundtrip_check.csv: per layer and format: the weights decoded from the saved .npz file are bit-identical to the in-memory decode, and (where an independent reference exists) identical to a torch-cast / plain NumPy simulated quantization of the FP32 tensor, i.e. the no-fault output equals the clean quantized reference
metric_definitions.accuracy: top-1 correct / total; drop_pp = FP32 accuracy - candidate accuracy on the SAME images
metric_definitions.cross_entropy: mean over images of the softmax cross-entropy, same images and criterion for all formats
metric_definitions.storage: payload_bytes = actual bytes of the stored words; scale_bytes = float32 scales; padding_bits = bits in payload beyond n*bits (INT4 odd count); total_bytes = payload + scales + codec metadata (none); theoretical_bits = n * bits, reported separately
metric_definitions.compression_ratio_weights: FP32 Conv/Linear weight bytes (8810240) / total_bytes (payload + scales); excludes biases, BatchNorm parameters and buffers
metric_definitions.compression_ratio_full_model: FP32 model bytes incl. non-quantized parameters and buffers (9083592) / (total_bytes + non-quantized parameters 136488 B + buffers 136864 B, both left FP32)

evaluation.precision: FP32 compute on decoded weights, model.eval(), inference_mode
evaluation.test: official 10,000 test images, evaluated only by --stage test after this manifest exists

config.saturation_clipping: |w| clipped to +-65504.0 before the cast (no overflow to inf)
config.nan_inf: encoder rejects non-finite input; the all-ones exponent (inf/NaN) is IEEE-reserved and is decoded as inf/NaN (reachable only through bit flips)
config.storage: actual encoded uint16 words; decoded to FP32 for evaluation (weight-only)
